statements.statement: Select board FY26 goal directs the board to develop, via the tri-board process, a recommendation to annual town meeting on the FY27 budget including potential budget cuts, level funding, or a Prop 2½ override, targeted for around February 2026.
MAR Connect program funding, previously covered by a 2024 special town meeting appropriation after grant funding was lost, was not carried forward into the FY2026 budget and the program ends June 30.

warnings.prediction: The school committee discussed level funding and possible cuts to level service in order to maintain programs for the coming year.

warnings.condition: if the tri-board does not commit to an earlier deadline
warnings.prediction: A member expressed concern that without a firm deadline the tri-board process will run out of time and produce a budget recommendation too late, as has happened in past years.
